responsibility: Defines the M32R target’s RTL constraint letters used by instruction recognition and reload. It assigns immediate-range constraints for signed, unsigned, shifted, compare-specific, and floating constants, plus target-specific address and memory-form constraints for 24-bit vs. 32-bit symbolic references, post-increment loads, pre-increment/pre-decrement stores, indirect pointer memory operands, zero constants, and internal accumulator/carry register classes, thereby describing which operands M32R machine patterns in the backend may legally accept.
